title: Word Frequency Counter
statement:
Given a sentence, count how many times each unique word appears.

Words are separated by spaces. The comparison is case-insensitive (treat all words as lowercase).

Print each word and its count, sorted alphabetically.
inputFormat: A single line containing the sentence.
outputFormat: For each unique word (alphabetical order), print: "word count".
constraints:
1 <= |S| <= 10^4
S contains only lowercase English letters and spaces.
Words are separated by single spaces with no leading or trailing spaces.

examples.input: the cat sat on the mat the cat
